primaryJob: Turn one complete source-bound Programmable project into one protected unreviewed Application V3.1 Draft or an exact actionable blocker without exposing internal package choreography.

primaryCommand.name: submit-project
primaryCommand.externalWriteBoundary: No fork, branch, commit, pull request, update, approval, merge, deployment, signing, launch, account change or funds action without the exact freshly recomputed confirmation digest.
primaryCommand.resume: The persistent workspace binds every local artifact, source commit and tree, central base, plan, receipt and safe next action. Reinvocation resumes idempotently from the last complete phase.

diagnostics.fullDetails: Available only in structured JSON or explicit verbose output. Unknown codes remain stable and actionable, never a generic inspect package message.

requiredBindings: supported closure and Draft transport capabilities
trusted repository numeric identity and default branch
compatibility.legacyFallback: Released Submit Launch bases without the compatibility file remain usable only when their existing active contract and schema digest exactly match the Builder fallback contract.

validatorPackage.goal: Generate one minimal immutable dependency closure containing only the public Applicant validator modules, schemas and receipt instead of mirroring the entire installed skill into protected Submit Launch.
validatorPackage.centralExecution: Submit Launch executes only the vendored package from the protected base under pull_request_target and never installs, checks out or executes candidate bytes.

help.rule: V1, canary, migration, Fee V2 replay and package-internal commands stay compatible but disappear from the normal Applicant help surface.

nonAuthority: Submission remains unreviewed and grants no review disposition, Registry acceptance, approval, deployment, discovery, routing, Website availability, signing, launch or funds authority.
